title: Matrix parity equations and transport across a boundary fold
reviewed_arguments: P0 fixes the odd-part sign and distinguishes arbitrary point data in the first contract from the forced trace in the second.
P1 proves the ordered matrix ODE, all parameter convergence, true inverse and inhomogeneous formula without assuming commutation.
P2 and P3 derive each Taylor coefficient explicitly; every recursion is on one common box. The second contract has an algebraic leading term.
P4 invokes the exact earlier parameter Borel proof and preserves J-invariance exactly. All mixed error jets vanish.
P5 proves both signed Cayley recurrences, local finiteness, ordered product derivative bounds, arbitrary flat powers and a smooth negative-side extension.
P6 preserves parameters, a specified common radial first integral, odd-coordinate rescaling and only permitted invertible normalizations.
T0 proves the ordered gauge and both directions of boundary descent through the actual characteristic quotient using the complete fold extension.
T1 and T2 retain multiplication order in both coefficient inverses and every particular-solution term. Forced values are not replaced by arbitrary normalization.

T3 obtains homogeneous transport with an actual first integral from the proved glancing pair. It explicitly leaves operator-derived amplitudes, boundary jets, symbol summation, PDE remainders and weak transfer unfinished.
Three complete exercises and the diagram are exact. The first panel distinguishes the w-fiber of J from the t-fiber of I. The vector panel has its actual zero axes.
All 15 proof entries, 388 earlier entries, 102 external human nodes and 11 maps were checked; no internal export closure or full propagation theorem is claimed.
